'''Degrime''' is a spell within the [[Arceuus spellbook]] that requires level 70 [[Magic]] and the completion of [[A Kingdom Divided]] to be cast.

Casting Degrime cleans all [[Herb#Normal_herbs|grimy herbs]] in a player's inventory, providing that the player has the required [[Herblore]] level to clean them normally. However, only half the Herblore experience is gained for cleaning herbs via the Degrime spell. For example, casting Degrime with [[grimy toadflax]] will only grant 4 Herblore experience per herb rather than 8.

{{Bug|Attempting to cast Degrime while the player is moving will queue up the action, but never actually cast the spell even once the player comes to a halt, despite repeated attempts yielding the message, {{mes|Your last spell is still in progress!}}. Thus, the player must stop moving and recast Degrime for it to actually trigger.}}
